title: VANTABLACK
body: Roll call. VANTABLACK again — or is it VANTABLUE tonight? The letters on the sheet have been written over. The radio is waiting. Through the window, the night asphalt of Sector 9 holds a single pair of tail-lights where the map says no road goes. He is already out there.

outcome.text: "Copy." He does not say all clear. He does not say anything else. The tail-lights hold, then ease forward into a street that will not be on your next work order.

choices.label: Use the name on the sheet, whatever it is.

outcome.text: You say it. He laughs, once, like a man who has heard his own eulogy. "Again, Operator?" The tail-lights dip — as if the car smiled — and the radio ticks with the wind between towers.
